name: WeBuild – IBAN Ownership Verification (IBAN-OV) – SD-JWT VC payload
description: Schema for the SD-JWT VC payload of an IBAN-OV attestation as defined in the IBAN-OV Rulebook (Chapter 3.2). This models the JSON claims set prior to SD-JWT disclosure/packing.

display.name: WeBuild – IBAN Ownership Verification (IBAN-OV)
display.description: Schema for the SD-JWT VC payload of an IBAN-OV attestation as defined in the IBAN-OV Rulebook (Chapter 3.2). This models the JSON claims set prior to SD-JWT disclosure/packing.

claims.description: URL at which a machine-readable version of the trust anchor used for verifying the IBAN-OV attestation can be found or looked up.
The legal category of the attestation as defined by eIDAS 2. For the IBAN-OV attestation issued by the bank (ASPSP) acting as an authorized issuer, this is 'EAA'.
Surname / family name of the natural person owning the account. Mandatory if owner_type = 'person'. SHALL NOT be present if owner_type = 'entity'.
Discriminator identifying whether the account owner is a legal person or a natural person. SHALL be present in all cases.
Array of objects containing unique identification strings of the legal entity owning the account.
Legal name of the legal entity owning the account. Mandatory if owner_type = 'entity'. SHALL NOT be present if owner_type = 'person'.
Given name(s) of the natural person owning the account. Mandatory if owner_type = 'person'. SHALL NOT be present if owner_type = 'entity'.

Identifies the legal owner of the account (the 'who'). The owner is either a legal person or a natural person. Required name attributes depend on owner_type. SHALL be individually selectively disclosable as a top-level claim.
Array of objects containing unique identification strings of the issuing financial institution.
Alpha-3 country code, as defined in ISO 3166-1, of the provider country or territory. SHALL be a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code.
International code (BIC or SWIFT code), as defined in ISO 9362, of the financial institution. SHALL conform to the ISO 9362:2022 format [A-Z]{6}[A-Z0-9]{2}([A-Z0-9]{3})?.
Country-specific code for internal routing within a specific country's clearing system. Optional attribute.
NACE code for activity specification (e.g. 64.19). Optional attribute.
Clearing number for identification of the financial institution, used only in some countries. Optional attribute.
Name of the financial institution providing the account.
Describes the financial institution that issued the account and related metadata (the 'where & how'). SHALL be individually selectively disclosable as a top-level claim.
Version of the IBAN-OV attestation schema used.
Name of the account, generated by the bank or customized by the owner.
International Bank Account Number, as defined in ISO 13616:2020. SHALL conform to the format [A-Z]{2}[0-9A-Z]{13,30}.
Nature of the bank account. SHOULD use one of the standardized values defined in Section 2.8.2 (e.g. CURRENT, SAVINGS, BASIC, LOAN, OTHER).
Currency code(s) used for the account, as defined in ISO 4217:2015. SHALL contain at least one valid ISO 4217:2015 currency code.
Core details of the bank account itself (the 'what'). SHALL be individually selectively disclosable as a top-level claim.
